properties.description: At the start of every investigation, load prior context: search team memory for similar incidents and state the current Grubify baseline before doing anything else.

hook.prompt:
Before you begin this investigation, do two things and state them explicitly:

1. Search team memory for previous incidents involving the same resource or the same symptom. If a match exists, summarise in one line what the cause was last time and what was done about it.
2. State the current known-good baseline for the affected Grubify service: active revision, CPU and memory limits, and replica bounds. Read these from Azure — do not assume them.

If either step returns nothing, say so plainly and continue. Do not fabricate prior context.
